metadata.case_name: LAU WA YING v. CARITAS - HONG KONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: personal care worker in elderly homes (PCW)
plaintiff.occupation_after: personal care worker in elderly homes (PCW)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: personal care worker in elderly homes (PCW)

source: the diagnosis was a soft tissue injury of back (Dr Chun further termed it as “minor trauma”) which should be the result of the accident;
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

source: On 9 August 2013, she attended Tung Chung Outpatient Clinic and was diagnosed with lower back and left foot sprain with soft tissue injury.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of other or unspecified parts of foot

injuries.description: a number of degenerative changes in her lower back
source: MRI on 27 August 2013 which showed a number of degenerative changes in her lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: She complains of continuous and non-stop low back pain on the left side, numbness of the left lower limb on the lateral aspect of the left thigh, leg and sole with pinpricking or no sensation, and intermittent left scapular pain since December 2013.
depressed mood, worries, annoyance, poor memory, poor sleep, self-blame, appetite loss and suicidality.
Physical examination showed mild tenderness over her lower back and the sole of her left foot.
X-ray showed no bone fracture. No neurological sign was noted.
Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode, which was caused by the accident and from which the plaintiff has recovered.

treatments_received: Attendance at A&E of Princess Margaret Hospital (initial assessment and discharge with medication)
Outpatient consultation at Tung Chung Outpatient Clinic
Consultations with a Chinese medical practitioner (four times between 13 and 20 August 2013)
Consultations with Dr Clarence Cheung (five visits, sick leave issued)
Consultations with Dr Pun Kam Wa (nine times between 3 October 2013 and 24 January 2014)
Admission to Emergency Medicine Ward (PMH) 16 October 2013 to 18 October 2013
Admission to Kwai Chung Hospital from 7 March 2014 until 1 April 2014
Physiotherapy: 13 sessions at North Lantau Hospital from 11 December 2013 to 5 March 2014
Orthopaedic Outpatient Clinic follow-up at PMH from 19 March 2014 until 20 July 2015
Occupational Therapy Department of NLH work hardening program (from 28 May 2014 to 31 December 2014) and transfer to United Christian Hospital outpatient services
Attendances at Tseung Kwan O Hospital A&E and private doctor in August 2015
Attendances at Kwai Chung Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Centre for schizophrenia with depression (from 8 September 2015 and after)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from soft tissue injury of back and associated left foot sprain and related symptoms.
Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode (psychiatric disorder) which the joint psychiatric report agreed was caused by the accident.
